ipxact:addressBlock.ipxact:name: abr_wrapper_key
ipxact:addressBlock.ipxact:description: Single AXI4-Lite window for all KM sideload interfaces to Adams Bridge. Contains four dual-share secret-seed inputs and one shared-key output.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: MLDSA_SEED
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Dual-share 256-bit secret seed (write-only) + key_valid flag. Layout identical to aes_wrapper_key for firmware reuse.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: KEY_SHARE0
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: One 32-bit word of key data. Write-only; reads return 0. No reset; powers up with undefined value.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: data
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 32-bit key data word. Write-only for security.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: KEY_SHARE1
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: One 32-bit word of key data. Write-only; reads return 0. No reset; powers up with undefined value.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: data
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 32-bit key data word. Write-only for security.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: KEY_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Seed control register. Writing KEY_VALID=1 marks the seed as loaded. Write 0 to invalidate. The KV shim gates the AB kv_read response on this bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: key_valid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When 1, the seed is loaded and the KV shim will serve it to Adams Bridge. Write 0 to invalidate and allow a new seed to be written.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: MLKEM_SHARED_KEY
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: 256-bit ML-KEM shared key output from Adams Bridge. Hardware writes KEY[*] and sets KEY_CTRL.KEY_VALID when ready. Firmware reads KEY[*] then writes KEY_CTRL=0 to consume/zeroize. IRQ_STATUS is a sticky W1C bit set by hardware on the key-ready event; the masked CPU interrupt is IRQ_STATUS & IRQ_ENABLE.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: KEY
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: One 32-bit word of ML-KEM shared key output. Written by hardware when key is ready; read by KM firmware to consume. Hardware clears all words to 0 when KEY_CTRL.KEY_VALID is cleared (via hwclr).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: data
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 32-bit shared-key word. Hardware writes on key-ready event; hardware clears to 0 on key-consume event (KEY_VALID cleared).

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: KEY_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Shared-key control. HW sets KEY_VALID when a new key is ready. Firmware writes 0 to clear (consume and zeroize).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: key_valid
rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: IRQ_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt status for ML-KEM shared key. Sticky bit set by hardware when a new shared key becomes valid; cleared by writing 1.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: key_valid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: ML-KEM shared key valid. Sticky, write 1 to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: IRQ_ENABLE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt enable for ML-KEM shared key. Mask for the PicoRV32 IRQ vector bit driven by the shared-key-valid event.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: key_valid_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 1 = enable PicoRV32 IRQ when ML-KEM shared key is valid. 0 = mask the interrupt (KEY_CTRL.KEY_VALID can still be polled).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved
